Whether it’s deploying machine learning models, optimizing cloud infrastructure, or guiding enterprise migrations—our mission is to turn complex data challenges into real-world impact.

The Role

We’re looking for a motivated Entry-Level Data Engineer/Analyst to join our data team and contribute to building, maintaining, and analyzing data pipelines that power business insights and AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will work alongside senior data engineers and analysts to support data ingestion, transformation, quality assurance, and reporting. You’ll gain hands-on experience with the modern data stack—including tools like Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, and Airflow—while building foundational skills in data modeling, SQL, Python, and analytics engineering. Goodwill Central Texas is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and support the data pipelines, integrations, and data models that make trusted information available for reporting, analytics, and operational use.
